maintenance_led.reason: Sells subscriptions to corporate learning content and the Percipio platform; this is not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private enterprises buying Percipio and course subscriptions for employees; government is a small share.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling Percipio subscriptions and content; past deals (Global Knowledge, Codecademy) were occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Corporate training content and learning platform can be replaced with moderate effort; switching is somewhat disruptive but not core operations.

notes: Switching cost is moderate: LMS migration and retraining are possible, but training is not operationally critical.
